at: the lamp is still lit when the boy arrives
alt: Lamplight in the timber palace: Queen Heo, flushed and teary, holds their loud newborn son while King Suro leans over them, completely undone.
scene: Intimate low three-quarter close two-shot inside a Golden Gaya timber chamber at night, dark umber floorboards and a paper screen melting into bokeh. QUEEN HEO HWANG-OK sits up against bolsters, hair loose and damp, cheeks flushed and eyes wet but laughing, holding a NEWBORN swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of warm gold #e0a33c silk at the edge of the wrap; the baby's mouth is wide open mid-yell. KING SURO kneels beside her, broad shoulders bent, one huge hand hovering over the tiny head as if afraid to touch it, his face wrecked with wonder. One oil lamp set on the floor at the lower left rakes up across the white swaddle, her rose silk and his jaw; gold #e0a33c lives in the lamp flame and the silk band, not a glow. Foreground: the out-of-focus lamp rim.

at: puts him in hands that have only ever held reins and swords
alt: At dawn in the yard, Muryuk in full armour holds his newborn son for the first time, stiff as a man handed a live coal.
scene: Worm's-eye medium shot from the packed-earth yard of a Silla noble house at dawn, giwa eaves and a pale white sky behind. MURYUK, a broad Gaya-born general in his fifties, still in full steel lamellar after a night standing in the yard, his Gaya helm (rounded iron bowl, wide flared brim, tall red horsehair plume) still on his head, holds a NEWBORN swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of sky-blue #3E8EF0 silk at the edge of the wrap, both arms rigid and held out a little from his chest as if the baby might shatter. His scarred face is frozen between terror and awe. In the soft midground a midwife in undyed white steps back, smiling. Low sun breaking over the eaves is the one hard key, raking across the steel plates and the white swaddle; sky-blue #3E8EF0 only in the silk band. Foreground: a blurred wooden post.

at: The boy is born in the county house at Manno
alt: The clerk’s wife has turned the newborn over to wash him and stopped: seven marks on his back, like the Dipper. Manmyung and Seohyun stare.
scene: High overhead three-quarter shot looking down into a plain county-house room at night, straw mats and a basin of steaming water. An older county woman in undyed white kneels with the NEWBORN laid belly-down across a white cotton cloth on her knees, a strip of Silla-blue #2A5FB8 silk folded beside him, the wash-cloth frozen in her hand; on the baby's tiny back, SEVEN small dark marks in the shape of the Big Dipper. Behind her, MANMYUNG, a young noblewoman exhausted and propped on bolsters, hair loose, lifts her head to look, half alarmed, half proud. SEOHYEON, a young Silla officer in plain blue-grey clothes, has half risen from his knees, mouth open. One floor lamp beside the basin is the hard key, catching the steam, the white cloth and the seven marks; Silla blue #2A5FB8 only in the folded silk, not a glow.

at: Manmyung lays the baby in his arms
alt: Old Muryuk, dying, holds his newborn grandson Yushin; Manmyung has just laid the baby in his arms and Seohyun leans in to hear him.
scene: Intimate close three-shot, slight high angle, in a dim county-house room at night. Very old MURYUK, white-haired, gaunt, propped on bolsters under a plain quilt, cradles a NEWBORN swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of Silla-blue #2A5FB8 silk at the edge of the wrap; the baby's tiny fist is closed around the old man's forefinger. His lips are just parted, saying one word, eyes wet and far away. MANMYUNG, young and tired, kneels at his side, her hands still lifted from laying the baby down. SEOHYEON, his grown son, leans in close from the other side, ear turned to his father's mouth, face tight with grief. One low lamp on the floor rakes across the old man's face, the white swaddle and the joined hands; Silla blue #2A5FB8 only in the silk band; deep umber falloff behind.

at: So the first heir arrives under Samsin's hand
alt: Yeon kneels beside his wife and their newborn son Namseng in the lamplit birth room, a big man suddenly careful.
scene: Low three-quarter close two-shot inside a Goguryeo house at night, timber posts, a faded painting of the birth goddess on the wall dissolving into bokeh. YEON'S WIFE lies back against bolsters, hair undone, damp with sweat, smiling a tired private smile at the NEWBORN on her chest, swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of brick-red #c25a4e silk at the edge of the wrap. YEON GESOMUN, a huge young Goguryeo commander still in his riding coat, kneels beside them, crown of his head bent low, one enormous scarred hand resting very lightly on the swaddle, his usually fierce face gone quiet and careful. One oil lamp on the floor at the right rakes across the white swaddle, her cheek and his knuckles; brick-red #c25a4e only in the silk band and the lamp's warm spill, not a glow. Foreground: a blurred lamp rim.

at: The first child is a boy who walks before he talks
alt: Munhee and Chunchu with their first child, Bupmin, wrapped in white and red, in the morning light of their room.
scene: Medium close two-shot, slight worm's-eye, inside a Silla noble chamber in early morning, paper lattice window and timber posts. MUNHEE sits on the floor quilt, hair loose with one simple pin, laughing down at a NEWBORN boy in her arms swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of crimson #C41E3A silk at the edge of the wrap, the baby's fists already punching free. CHUNCHU sits close behind her shoulder in a loose magenta robe, chin almost on her shoulder, staring at the baby with a stunned, foolish smile, one finger caught in the tiny fist. A raking shaft of morning light through the paper lattice is the one hard key, catching the white swaddle and the crimson band; crimson #C41E3A in the silk, magenta only in his sleeve sheen. Foreground: an out-of-focus lattice edge.

at: A year later comes a girl who talks early and never stops
alt: A year later, a daughter: Chunchu holds newborn Gotaso in white and pink while little Bupmin stretches up to see and Munhee watches.
scene: Close three-quarter shot from just below, same Silla noble chamber in soft afternoon light. CHUNCHU, in a loose magenta robe, sits cross-legged holding a NEWBORN girl swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of soft pink #F0A3C0 silk at the edge of the wrap; his hand looks enormous around her, and she is already mid-squall. A one-year-old toddler boy in a tiny white jeogori with a red tie clings to his father's sleeve on tiptoe, peering in suspiciously. MUNHEE leans in from behind, hair loose, amused, one hand on the toddler's back. Window light through paper lattice from the right is the one hard key on the white swaddle and the pink band; pink #F0A3C0 in the silk, not a glow. Foreground: a blurred quilt fold.

alt: Ink: under the sacred birch, Ungnyeo holds the newborn Dangun while Hwanung bends over them; the great bear’s shape lingers in the ink behind her.
scene: Worm's-eye ink painting under one enormous sacred birch whose trunk is a single hard black vertical stroke dividing the frame, roots spreading into bare paper mist. UNGNYEO, the bear-born woman, kneels at the foot of the birch in a simple white robe, holding a NEWBORN swaddled in white with a band of the ONE translucent warm tan #b8956a wash on the swaddle's edge — the only colour in the frame. HWANUNG, son of heaven, bends over her from the right, long hair and robes in sweeping calligraphic strokes, one hand on the birch. Behind Ungnyeo, a vast faint shape of a great bear is suggested only by a few wet dark ink masses, her first form. Topknots, no brimmed hats.

alt: Gyebek’s memory: at home in lamplight, his small son asleep in white and yellow, holding his finger, while his wife sleeps beside them.
scene: Extreme close-up, overhead, in a plain Baekje house at night: GYEBEK, young, in a loose undyed white house robe, lies on his side on a sleeping mat, absolutely still, face soft and watchful in a way nobody on a battlefield has seen; a four-month-old BABY swaddled in plain white cotton with a narrow band of Baekje yellow #d9b13a silk at the edge of the wrap sleeps against his chest, the tiny fist closed hard around his forefinger. Behind him, out of focus, his young wife sleeps with one arm thrown over them both. One small oil lamp on the floor at the lower edge is the only key, raking across his cheekbone, the white swaddle, the joined hands; Baekje yellow #d9b13a in the silk band and the lamp's spill, not a glow. Deep umber dark everywhere else.
